text: CalendarDialog retains a hasConnected guard for template cloning and listener wiring, but translateFragment and show-promise setup run after the guard. Its original base class was HTMLDialogElement; current code extends PositionedDialog. Preserve one-time child initialization separately from repeat connection work in this component, and do not describe the old empty dialog as the complete current implementation. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Clone the Calendar dialog template once and translate after each connection
